applicabilityBasis.summary: JPYdf is a decentralized overcollateralized CDP token minted by borrowers on immutable Liquity v2 smart contracts against wstETH and USDC. Primary documentation and interface terms explicitly disclaim any fiat currency status, yen-denominated monetary claim, yen redemption right, or issuer buyback obligation; protocol redemptions exchange JPYdf only for variable quantities of dToken crypto collateral, which falls outside the GENIUS Act section 2(22)(A)(ii) fixed monetary-value issuer redemption requirement. The web app operated by JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC also excludes all U.S. persons and territories.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-27. Token identity is anchored to Ethereum contract 0xb122f4a154f84708407213d6a715181180012f45 (JpydfToken). DeltaForesight is the protocol developer and JPYdf Foundation DAO LLC operates only the web interface (app.jpydf.com, referencing Marshall Islands domestic sanctions in its November 6, 2026 Terms of Use while excluding Japan and the United States) and explicitly disclaims any issuer obligation to redeem JPYdf or make up shortfalls; therefore issuerEntity, issuerDomicile, and licensingRegulator are omitted rather than attributed to a legal issuer. Protocol collateral redemptions return dTokens (dUSDC or dwstETH) rather than fixed monetary value, so redemptionPolicyPresent is false under the tracker definition. No conventional issuer reserve-attestation series exists. Authorization, pathway, foreign exception, and enforcement findings are dated bounded public-evidence negatives as of 2026-11-27.
